title: Terraform Industries
summary: California start-up making synthetic natural gas from sunlight, water and atmospheric CO2.
bodyHtml:
Terraform Industries is developing a process that combines direct air capture with electrolysis to produce methane that can drop into existing gas infrastructure.

The company's thesis is that cheap solar electricity makes synthetic fuel cost-competitive with fossil gas, creating a drop-in decarbonisation path.

Why it matters

  • Solar-driven synthetic methane
  • Drop-in gas compatibility
  • Modular production units

businessMeaning: Synthetic fuels avoid rebuilding end-use infrastructure, but they compete on cost with gas that is already cheap. Solar economics are the swing factor.
investmentLens: Private; a high-risk bet on solar cost curves rather than on policy credits.
